comment: sha256 of each PREVIOUSLY RELEASED receiver template, with the tag range it shipped in. Recorded by reading `git show <tag>:plugins/runtime/receivers/<file>` across every plugin-runtime tag. This is what lets an installed file be reported as a known out-of-date shape rather than as an unrecognized one; without it `legacy` and `foreign` collapse into a single unhelpful 'not current'. Append a shape when a release ships a new template; never edit an existing entry, since it records what a past release actually contained.
